user.description:
1. Open [this link]({auth_url}) and immediatelly open Developer Console in browser (F12).
2. Log in with your Samsung account (if needed)
 3. Find the **login.do** request in Network tab
 4. Copy the **auth_server_url** and **code** from URL query parameter.
Continue with the button below.

code.description:
Enter the authorization code you received after logging in with your Samsung account.
 Code is included in URL query parameter.
